name.ja: Berendsen弱結合サーモスタット

group.ja: 温度制御・分子動力学

summary.ja: 目標温度との差を緩和時間で減衰させる速度スケーリング。温度の揺らぎが抑制され、正しい正準分布の生成器にはならない。
summary.en: Relax the temperature difference over a chosen coupling time using velocity scaling. Fluctuations are suppressed, so this is not a correct canonical sampler.

caution.ja: 歴史的な温度緩和法として扱い、NVTでの揺らぎ・応答の測定にはそのまま使わない。
caution.en: Treat as a historical relaxation method; do not assume correct NVT fluctuations or response properties.

references.label: Berendsen et al. (1984), Molecular dynamics with coupling to an external bath
references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

references.label: GROMACS: temperature coupling
references.scope: Bibliographic entry and introductory comparison; full derivation and numerical reproduction have not been audited.

next_deliverable.ja: 専用の定式化・積分手順を整理し、固定入力、自由度・乱数・刻み幅を明記した分布と時間相関の検証例を追加する。
next_deliverable.en: Add a dedicated formulation and integration recipe, followed by explicit-input distribution and time-correlation checks with stated degrees of freedom, random seeds and step sizes.

limitations.ja: 比較解説を公開。Under construction：専用の実装・数値検証結果はまだありません。
